tasks.short: Prescribe physical therapy for appropriate functional goals

steps.what: Assess suitability and prescribe physical therapy for muscle and strength goals

tasks.design: Retain patient-specific physical therapy selection and prescription in the clinical ordering system {OTHER}. Native order screens remain available, but no model chooses treatment or infers suitability from incomplete records.
tasks.previous_blocker: A prescription requires matching treatment goals to an individual assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Electronic ordering supports the decision without establishing less decision time.
tasks.still_hard: Tolerance, functional limitations and contraindications require clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The physician decides whether the proposed therapy is appropriate and when reassessment is needed.
tasks.altitude: Prescribing authority and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify functional goals and review conditions in a referral
reach.learn: Therapy scope and shared outcome terminology

evidence.claim: Keeping physical therapy prescribing human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; the digest supplies no validated automated therapy-selection capability.

assumptions: Boundary is the physician's suitability decision and prescription, not delivery of physical therapy or the broader rehabilitation plan.

The physician produces and checks the exact patient, therapy, functional objective and review conditions during s1; all capture and approval time remains. No machine action or free structured contraindication flag is assumed.
Existing native ordering remains; no custom code or automatic treatment selection is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is introduced. Local professional scope requires customer confirmation.
unknowns: Current order workflow and professional scope
research_questions: Which patient-specific factors require clarification before a physical therapy prescription?

already_counted.description: Therapy selection, capture and final prescription check

approvals.approved_version: Exact prescription with patient identity, therapy choice, objectives and review conditions; changes require another physician check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Selection, prescription capture and approval retain all time; existing order-system runtime earns no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate therapy-service indications, limitations and rehabilitation objectives
Prescribe selected therapy services with patient-specific instructions and review conditions

tasks.design: Keep modality assessment and prescribing with the physician. The clinical ordering system {OTHER} records the selected service and instructions; no list of example modalities is treated as an approved programme for every patient.
tasks.previous_blocker: The relevant service and its appropriateness depend on the actual patient and indication.
tasks.enabler_now: An electronic order catalogue does not replace clinical selection.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence, contraindications, goals and treatment response must be weighed individually.
tasks.human_edge: The physician can reject a listed service when it is unsuitable and seek further specialist input.
tasks.altitude: Service-selection and prescribing responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the intended goal and limits of a modality referral

evidence.claim: Retaining patient-specific therapy-service prescribing is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; no digest case establishes safe automated selection.

assumptions: Boundary covers modality-service selection and prescription. General physical therapy goals are handled in their separate task; a roll-up must not count an identical prescription twice.

The physician captures patient identity, selected service, indication, instructions and review conditions in s2, retaining all 35 hours. Missing information causes clinical clarification; no automated execution is proposed.
Use existing native ordering; no custom recommendation engine is proposed.
Zero additional upkeep because no process changes. Actual authorised modalities and national rules are customer facts.
unknowns: Services actually offered and professional scope
Whether this overlaps a general physical therapy prescription

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient-specific service prescription, indication, instructions and review conditions; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Assessment, order entry and final prescription check remain human; no catalogue runtime is counted as labour.

tasks.short: Instruct interns and residents in rehabilitation medicine

steps.what: Instruct interns and residents through case discussion and supervised clinical practice

tasks.design: Retain clinical instruction, observation and corrective feedback with the physician. Existing teaching references in {DOCS} support the encounter without replacing supervision of diagnosis and treatment reasoning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trainee competence must be observed in context.
tasks.enabler_now: Generated explanations do not establish safe independent clinical reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: A confident answer may conceal a missed finding or unsafe assumption.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor probes reasoning and intervenes when patient care requires it.
tasks.altitude: Teaching and supervision responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Identify recurrent reasoning gaps for future teaching

evidence.claim: Keeping clinical trainee instruction human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is direct instruction and supervision, not course administration or creation of teaching publications.
No automated competence flag or structured trainee assessment is presumed.
Existing references suffice; no custom learning system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because this activity does not change.
research_questions: Which diagnostic or treatment-reasoning gaps emerge only during observed practice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Clinical teaching and supervision remain counted; no invented slide-writing baseline.

reach: Clarify therapy referral objectives with therapists
